mlxConsole.pythonPath.description: Path to a Python 3 interpreter used to create the managed virtual environment. Leave empty to auto-detect.

mlxConsole.venvPath.description: Directory for the managed Python virtual environment where mlx-lm is installed. Leave empty to prefer a workspace .venv (if it has mlx-lm) or the extension's global storage.

mlxConsole.modelsDir.description: Directory where models are downloaded and cached (sets HF_HOME; models live under <dir>/hub). Shared with mlx_lm.server and the Hugging Face CLI. Leave empty for the default (~/.cache/huggingface).

mlxConsole.server.host.description: Host the mlx_lm.server binds to (ignored when Expose to LAN is on).

mlxConsole.server.autoStart.description: Start the server automatically when it is first needed.

mlxConsole.server.exposeToLan.description: Bind the server to 0.0.0.0 so other machines/tools can reach it. Security risk on untrusted networks.

mlxConsole.server.apiKey.description: Optional bearer token required for served requests (also shown in external-client snippets).

mlxConsole.webUi.enabled.markdownDescription: Serve an editable dashboard on `http://127.0.0.1`. **Loopback only** — it ignores Expose to LAN and cannot be reached from another machine. Every request needs a per-session token, because any web page open in your browser can send requests to localhost. On by default; run **MLX: Open Web Dashboard (local)** to open it.

mlxConsole.webUi.requireToken.markdownDescription: Require a per-session token in the dashboard URL. Off by default: the dashboard already refuses cross-site requests, which is what a malicious web page would have to make. Turn it on if other people have accounts on this Mac — a loopback port is reachable by every local user, and only the token keeps them out.

mlxConsole.webUi.port.markdownDescription: Port for the local dashboard. Use 0 to let the OS pick a free one. A second VS Code window takes an OS-assigned port automatically rather than failing. Bound to 127.0.0.1 regardless.

mlxConsole.server.extraArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to mlx_lm.server for machine-specific tuning (e.g. context/KV-cache limits, chat template). Run `mlx_lm.server --help` to see available flags.

mlxConsole.defaultModel.description: Default MLX model repo id used for chat when none is selected.

mlxConsole.huggingFace.token.description: Optional Hugging Face token for higher rate limits and gated models.

mlxConsole.server.promptCacheSize.description: Maximum number of distinct KV caches held in the prompt cache (mlx_lm.server --prompt-cache-size). 0 uses the server default.

mlxConsole.server.promptCacheBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum size of the KV/prompt caches (`mlx_lm.server --prompt-cache-bytes`). Accepts a size such as `8 GB` or `512 MB`; a bare number is read as MB. **Unbounded by default** — the server then trims only by entry count, so long conversations can grow into whatever the model leaves free. See the live recommendation in Metrics. 0 leaves the server default.

mlxConsole.server.decodeConcurrency.markdownDescription: Sequences decoded in parallel (`mlx_lm.server --decode-concurrency`). **Each parallel sequence holds its own KV cache**, so this multiplies memory: at a 131072-token window and ~72 KiB/token, one sequence is ~9.7 GB. The server default is **32**, sized for a shared inference host — a single-user editor rarely needs more than 1–4. 0 leaves the server default.

mlxConsole.server.promptConcurrency.markdownDescription: Prompts prefilled in parallel (`mlx_lm.server --prompt-concurrency`). Server default **8**. Raises prefill throughput for concurrent requests at the cost of transient memory. 0 leaves the server default.

mlxConsole.server.prefillStepSize.markdownDescription: Tokens per prefill step (`mlx_lm.server --prefill-step-size`). Server default **2048**. Larger steps prefill faster but need more transient memory; lower it if long prompts cause pressure. 0 leaves the server default.

mlxConsole.server.draftModel.markdownDescription: Small model used for speculative decoding (`mlx_lm.server --draft-model`). Loaded **in addition** to the main model, so its weights count against the same GPU ceiling — check headroom in Metrics first. Empty disables speculation.

mlxConsole.server.numDraftTokens.markdownDescription: Tokens proposed per speculation step (`mlx_lm.server --num-draft-tokens`). Server default **3**. Only used when a draft model is set. 0 leaves the server default.

mlxConsole.contextWindow.markdownDescription: Context window advertised to VS Code for MLX models (`maxInputTokens`). **Leave unset to read each model's real window from its own `config.json`** (`max_position_embeddings`); setting a value here overrides that for every model. VS Code uses this to decide how much history **and how many tool definitions** to send in agent mode — a large native + MCP tool set can need 32k on its own.

mlxConsole.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens an MLX model may generate in one response.

mlxConsole.sampling.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Lower is more deterministic (good for code).
